name: docker-mcp-server
description: Manage Docker through the Docker SDK for Python and the docker CLI: containers, images, networks, volumes, Compose, Swarm, Buildx, Scout, and OCI registries, exposed as MCP tools.

docker_hosts.title: Docker host(s)
docker_hosts.description: Docker daemon(s) to manage. Blank = your default Docker context / socket. One remote: ssh://user@host (recommended; auth via your SSH keys), tcp://host:2375 for a plaintext TCP daemon, or tcp://host:2376(tls=/path/to/certs) for a TLS daemon (the directory needs ca.pem, which verifies the daemon - a self-signed daemon works - plus cert.pem/key.pem only if it requires a client cert). Several: comma-separated name=endpoint pairs, e.g. local=auto, prod=ssh://ops@prod.example.com(ro) - append (ro) to make a host read-only, or (nd) to block only destructive calls (kills/removals/prunes) on it. Append (redact) to redact credentials in that host's output only, which is not access control: see https://github.com/L337-org/docker-mcp/blob/main/REDACTION.md. When set, this replaces DOCKER_HOST.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Register only read-only tools - no create, modify, or delete.

no_destructive.title: Disable destructive tools
no_destructive.description: Register everything except destructive tools (remove / prune / kill).

disable_domains.title: Disabled domains
disable_domains.description: Comma-separated tool domains to drop, e.g. swarm,plugins,scout.

redact.title: Redact credentials
redact.description: Replace credentials in everything the server returns with [REDACTED:...] markers, on every host. Reduces accidental exposure only: it is not access control, and an agent that can run commands in a container can still read a credential. Use it with read-only mode. Read https://github.com/L337-org/docker-mcp/blob/main/REDACTION.md first.

redact_names.title: Redacted variable names
redact_names.description: Extra variable names whose values redaction treats as credentials: comma-separated, case-insensitive, * and ? globs, and ! to exclude a built-in name (UPSTREAM_*, !SORT_KEY). Names only, never values. Has no effect unless redaction is on. See https://github.com/L337-org/docker-mcp/blob/main/REDACTION.md.
